translate_en|mods/YetAnotherInstantItemT: Yet Another Instant Item Transfer
Handle drag-drop to floor
Multiplayer global: when enabled, dragging items outside the inventory UI onto the world drops them instantly in a batch; when disabled, vanilla one-by-one drop is used.
Handle magazine ammo transfer
Multiplayer global: when enabled, moving ammo into inventory while loading magazines/guns is instant for all players.
Handle Take All&Half / Transfer All
Multiplayer global: when enabled, Take All, Take Half, and Transfer All use instant transfer for all players.
Wait for current timed action before transfer
Multiplayer global: when enabled, instant transfers wait until the current TimedAction finishes; when disabled, transfers run immediately (without interrupting the current action). Default off.
Single-player only. In multiplayer, the server Sandbox options control everyone.
